mapper.sql: id, execute_date, period_code, contract_code, client_code, org_id, inbound_date, receivable_rent_balance, receivable_residual_value_balance, receivable_outtax_balance, unrealized_revenue_balance, lessee_margin_balance, financial_exposure, recycling_equipment_cost, provision_for_impairment, substract_balance, net_worth, provisional_receipts_balance, outbound_date, outbound_type, deal_amount, receivable_service_outtax_amount, profit_loss, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time

with sub as ( select ereid.contract_code --合同编码 ,ereid.client_code --客户编码 ,ereid.client_name --客户名称 ,ereid.org_id --签约主体 ,ereid.inbound_date --入库日期 ,ereid.receivable_rent_balance --应收租金 ,ereid.receivable_residual_value_balance --应收期末残值 ,ereid.receivable_outtax_balance --应收销项税 ,ereid.unrealized_revenue_balance --未实现收益 ,ereid.lessee_margin_balance --承租人保证金 -- ,ecbl_t.receivable_rent_balance --应收租金 -- ,ecbl_t.receivable_residual_value_balance --应收期末残值 -- ,ecbl_t.receivable_outtax_balance --应收销项税 -- ,ecbl.unrealized_revenue_balance --未实现收益 -- ,ecbl_t.lessee_margin_balance --承租人保证金 ,ereid.recycling_equipment_cost --回收设备成本 ,ereid.provision_for_impairment --入库时计提减值 -- ,COALESCE(ereod.provision_for_impairment,0)-COALESCE(ereid.provision_for_impairment,0) substract_balance --回收设备减值 ,ecbl_t.provisional_receipts_balance --暂收款项 ,COALESCE(substring(ertd1.business_date,1,10), substring(ertd2.message_content ->>'businessDate',1,10),ereod.outbound_date) outbound_date --出库日期 ,case when ertd1.business_date is not null then '处置' when ertd2.message_content ->>'businessDate' is not null then '赎回' else null end as outbound_type --出库类型 ,case when ertd1.business_date is not null then ertd1.deal_amount else null end as deal_amount_temp --处置金额 -- ,greatest(COALESCE(ecb.receivable_outtax_amount,0),0)+greatest(COALESCE(ecb.receivable_service_outtax_amount,0),0) receivable_service_outtax_amount --应交销项税 -- ,COALESCE(ecbl.asset_dispose_gain_balance,0)+COALESCE(ecbl.asset_dispose_loss_balance,0) profit_loss --融资租赁资产处置损益 from (select * from eg_recycling_equipment_in_detail detail where detail.del_flag='0' and exists (select 1 from eg_recycling_equipment_in head where head.del_flag ='0' and head.process_status in ('2','3','4') and detail.inbound_date = head.inbound_date and detail.org_id = head.org_id and detail.recycle_id = head.id)) ereid left join (select org_id,contract_code,sum(unrealized_revenue_balance) unrealized_revenue_balance,sum(asset_dispose_gain_balance) asset_dispose_gain_balance,sum(asset_dispose_loss_balance) asset_dispose_loss_balance from eg_contract_balance_latest where del_flag = '0' group by org_id,contract_code) ecbl on ereid.org_id = ecbl.org_id and ereid.contract_code = ecbl.contract_code left join (select org_id, contract_code, sum(provisional_receipts_balance) provisional_receipts_balance from eg_contract_balance_latest where del_flag = '0' and coalesce(scene_code,'') not in('RKCZ', 'RKSH', 'CWCK') group by org_id, contract_code) ecbl_t on ereid.org_id = ecbl_t.org_id and ereid.contract_code = ecbl_t.contract_code left join eg_recycling_equipment_out_detail ereod on ereid.org_id = ereod.org_id and ereid.contract_code = ereod.contract_code and ereod.del_flag = '0' -- left join eg_contract_balance ecb on ereid.org_id = ecb.org_id and ereid.contract_code = ecb.contract_code and ereid.client_code = ecb.client_code left join ( select rkcz.contract_code, rkcz.org_id, rkcz.business_date,rkcz.create_time,sum(rkcz.ebankAmount::numeric) deal_amount from ( select id, contract_code , -- json_array_elements((message_content ->>'receivableUnconfirmList')::json)->> 'orgId' org_id , org_id, json_array_elements((message_content ->>'receivableUnconfirmList')::json)->> 'ebankAmount' ebankAmount, message_content ->>'businessDate' business_date, create_time from eg_raw_transaction_data t1 where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.message_status ='SUCCESS' and exists ( select 1 from ( select distinct field_code, source_value, target_value from eg_field_mapping where field_code = 'sceneCode')t2 where t1.scene_code = t2.source_value and t2.target_value = 'RKCZ' ) )rkcz group by rkcz.contract_code, rkcz.org_id, rkcz.business_date,rkcz.create_time) ertd1 on ereid.org_id = ertd1.org_id and ereid.contract_code = ertd1.contract_code and ertd1.create_time >=to_date(ereid.inbound_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') left join (select * from eg_raw_transaction_data t1 where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.message_status ='SUCCESS' and exists ( select 1 from ( select distinct field_code, source_value, target_value from eg_field_mapping where field_code = 'sceneCode')t2 where t1.scene_code = t2.source_value and t2.target_value = 'RKSH' )) ertd2 on ereid.org_id = ertd2.org_id and ereid.contract_code = ertd2.contract_code and ertd2.create_time >=to_date(ereid.inbound_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
, basic as ( select distinct org_id ,contract_code ,to_char(to_date(outbound_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM')::integer outbound_date from sub --where outbound_type = '处置' and contract_code = 'KCE21124462' ) , ev_eve as ( select ev.*,eve.account_code, eve.debit_amount, eve.credit_amount from eg_voucher ev join eg_voucher_entry eve on ev.id = eve.voucher_id and eve.del_flag ='0' where ev.del_flag = '0' and exists (select 1 from basic where basic.outbound_date is not null and ev.org_id = basic.org_id and ev.contract_code = basic.contract_code and ev.period_code >= basic.outbound_date-1 and ev.period_code <= basic.outbound_date+1) ) , ev_val as ( select ev_eve.org_id, ev_eve.contract_code,sub.outbound_type,ev_eve.scene_code,ev_eve.account_code,ev_eve.interface_data_id,max(ev_eve.interface_data_id) over(partition by ev_eve.org_id, ev_eve.contract_code), case when sub.outbound_type = '处置' and ev_eve.scene_code = 'RKCZ' and (ev_eve.account_code = '6115.01.01' or ev_eve.account_code = '6115.01.02') and ev_eve.interface_data_id = max(ev_eve.interface_data_id) then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) else null end profit_loss, case when sub.outbound_type = '处置' and ev_eve.scene_code = 'RKCZ' and ev_eve.account_code = '2221.01.05' and ev_eve.interface_data_id = max(ev_eve.interface_data_id) then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) else null end receivable_service_outtax_amount, case when sub.outbound_type = '处置' and ev_eve.scene_code = 'RKCZ' and ev_eve.account_code = '2241.19' and ev_eve.interface_data_id = max(ev_eve.interface_data_id) then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) else null end provisional_receipts_amount, case when sub.outbound_type = '处置' and ev_eve.scene_code = 'RKCZ' and ev_eve.account_code = '1461.02.02' and ev_eve.interface_data_id = max(ev_eve.interface_data_id) then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) when sub.outbound_type = '赎回' and ev_eve.scene_code = 'RKSH' and ev_eve.account_code = '1461.02.02' and ev_eve.interface_data_id = max(ev_eve.interface_data_id) then sum(ev_eve.credit_amount) * -1 else sum(ereod.provision_for_impairment) end substract_balance, case when sub.outbound_type = '处置' and ev_eve.scene_code = 'RKCZ' and ev_eve.account_code = '1461.02.01' and ev_eve.interface_data_id = max(ev_eve.interface_data_id) then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) when sub.outbound_type = '赎回' and ev_eve.scene_code = 'RKSH' and ev_eve.account_code = '1461.02.02' and ev_eve.interface_data_id = max(ev_eve.interface_data_id) over(partition by ev_eve.org_id, ev_eve.contract_code) then sum(ev_eve.debit_amount) else sum(ereod.recycling_equipment_cost) end recycling_equipment_account_balance from ev_eve left join sub on sub.org_id = ev_eve.org_id and sub.contract_code = ev_eve.contract_code left join eg_recycling_equipment_out_detail ereod on ev_eve.org_id = ereod.org_id and ev_eve.contract_code = ereod.contract_code and ereod.del_flag ='0' group by ev_eve.org_id, ev_eve.contract_code,sub.outbound_type,ev_eve.scene_code,ev_eve.account_code,ev_eve.interface_data_id ) , ev_val_grp as ( select ev_val.org_id, ev_val.contract_code, sum(COALESCE(ev_val.provisional_receipts_amount,0)) provisional_receipts_amount, sum(ev_val.profit_loss) profit_loss, sum(ev_val.receivable_service_outtax_amount) receivable_service_outtax_amount, sum(ev_val.substract_balance) substract_balance, sum(ev_val.recycling_equipment_account_balance) recycling_equipment_account_balance from ev_val group by ev_val.org_id, ev_val.contract_code ) ,balance_max_id as ( select ecb.org_id, ecb.contract_code, ecb.client_code,ecb.bill_contract_code, max(id) max_id from eg_contract_balance ecb join sub on ecb.contract_code = sub.contract_code and ecb.org_id = sub.org_id and sub.outbound_date is not null where ecb.del_flag = '0' and ecb.period_code::text <= replace(substring(sub.outbound_date,1,7) ,'-','') and ecb.scene_code in ('RKCZ', 'RKSH', 'CWCK') and sub.outbound_type is not null group by ecb.org_id, ecb.contract_code, ecb.client_code,ecb.bill_contract_code ) ,balance_value as ( select ecb.org_id, ecb.contract_code, sum(-1*ecb.receive_cost_amount) recycling_equipment_account_balance from eg_contract_balance ecb where ecb.del_flag = '0' and id in (select max_id from balance_max_id) group by ecb.contract_code , ecb.org_id ) , res as ( select sub.*,ev_val_grp.profit_loss, ev_val_grp.receivable_service_outtax_amount, ev_val_grp.substract_balance, balance_value.recycling_equipment_account_balance, COALESCE(sub.deal_amount_temp,0) + COALESCE(ev_val_grp.provisional_receipts_amount,0) as deal_amount from sub left join ev_val_grp on sub.org_id = ev_val_grp.org_id and sub.contract_code = ev_val_grp.contract_code left join balance_value on sub.org_id = balance_value.org_id and sub.contract_code = balance_value.contract_code )
